en.name: Innocent VII
en.summary: A Roman-line pope during the Western Schism whose reign was disrupted by a violent Roman revolt that briefly forced him to flee the city.
en.body: Innocent VII, elected on the condition that he pursue reunion efforts to end the ongoing schism, faced a serious popular uprising in Rome partly provoked by his nephew's brutal actions against protesting citizens, forcing the pope to flee temporarily to Viterbo. He founded a short-lived reform of the University of Rome before his death, with the schism still unresolved.
